svg.title: QPX benchmark on PXD007683
svg.desc: Local measurements of three matching LFQ PSM queries, related LFQ and TMT output sizes after relayout, and increases in peak RSS. The time axis is logarithmic, in milliseconds; storage is linear, in MiB. Times and memory are medians of five fresh processes on a warm OS page cache, excluding imports, conversion and relayout. The workflows use different engines; related storage outputs differ in layout and contents, and relayout reduces selected numeric precision. All values and methodology are also stated in the README; full measurement records are embedded in metadata.

svg.text: PXD007683 · local LFQ queries and LFQ / TMT storage
Five fresh processes per query · warm OS page cache · median time and memory · conversion and relayout excluded
QPX after relayout · MiB · linear axis
Increase in peak RSS above the imported process · MiB
Memory excludes the import baseline; it is not total process RSS.
Queries compare reading workflows and engines: pandas parses the full gzip mzTab PSM section; DuckDB reads the requested Parquet data.
Unfiltered Parquet counts use footer metadata. The sequence/charge multisets match exactly by bidirectional EXCEPT ALL.
Storage scope: LFQ mzTab + MSstats versus six QPX views; TMT MSstats versus feature only. Contents and row layouts differ.
relayout sorts records, remaps IDs and reduces selected numeric precision. These sizes are not a lossless compression ratio.
Intel Core Ultra 7 270K Plus · 24 logical CPUs / DuckDB threads · 122.9 GiB RAM · Python 3.13.9 · DuckDB 1.5.2 · pandas 2.3.3 · PyArrow 24
